section_path: 4.1 Uncertain effects produced by stochastic simulation

note:
Paper 82, Team 35778, twenty-two pages, a 2015 paper that models ICM's staffing as a network and then simulates twenty years of hiring, promotion and churn. Twenty-three measured regions: twenty-one figure rows, one table row and one refusal, nothing unaccounted and nothing unresolved. The paper prints Figures 1 to 21 with no gap in the numbering and one numbered table, and every one of them owns a region - the first census in this batch with no declared gap.

The first finding is a labelling failure that runs through the second half of the paper. The churn sweep is printed as two caption pairs, 25 per cent and 35 per cent, and the 35 per cent panel of each pair prints 25 per cent on its own rotated axis: Figure 12 is titled 'enthusiasim when churn rate=25%' and Figure 14 prints 'benefit per month when churn rate=25%'. The two panels of each pair are also drawn on different y windows, so the comparison the captions promise cannot be made either by label or by shape. Neither half of the 35 per cent case is recoverable from the artwork.

The second finding is the caption layer doing nothing. Twenty of the twenty-one captions are bare noun phrases of three to eleven words, none names a variable, a unit, a condition or a conclusion, and two of them stop mid-phrase at 'of two recruitment'. The paper's own readings live in the body prose, which is fine, but the captions are the only text that survives extraction for eight of these rows, and every one of those eight is a picture.

The third is a measurement note rather than a paper fault: the caption glyph runs on pp6-20 have no space glyph in the embedded subset, so the text layer returns 'Figure1: Staffdistributionstructureineachdivision' and the vector axis titles come back reversed. Every caption and every axis reading in this record was taken from the proxies.

Table 1 is the paper's only grid, three horizontal rules with no vertical, and it is filed under 3.2 by hand because the heading index follows the last heading on the page, which is '4 Sensitivity Analysis' printing below the table. Both p20 figures needed the same treatment in reverse - the index files them under the conclusion that prints below them, while the section that reads them, 4.2, starts below the pictures as well.
rules: Families: line x13, flowchart-or-schematic x3, node-link-network x3, scatter x2, bar x1, table-grid x1, over twenty-two rows from twenty-three measured regions plus one excluded title sheet [geometry.family].

The excluded region is the title-and-summary sheet on p1, one 310-path vector block at 0.846 of the page holding the title, the running head and 29 abstract lines and no artwork at all - it is larger than every exhibit in the paper and is still not one [place.area_frac].

The caption family noun does not decide the family here: Figure 1 is captioned a 'Staff distribution structure' and the pixels are an organigram of boxes on connectors, so it is recorded flowchart-or-schematic, and Figure 13 is captioned a 'diagram' and the pixels are 100 isolated points with no connecting stroke, so it is recorded scatter [geometry.family].

Figures 7 and 8 are ten simulation runs per month drawn as ten polylines stacked in a perspective box with no depth axis, no depth tick and no key - a 3-D ribbon, recorded three_d with the family left as line because the marks are still time series [geometry.three_d].

Figure 19 is the only exhibit drawn in three stacked planes and the only one whose labels print OUTSIDE the artwork: 'human capital layer', 'competition layer' and 'friendship layer' sit on the left margin, and no key explains the dotted inter-layer edges [geometry.legend].

FOUR CAPTIONS CARRY A PRINTED CHURN RATE THE PANEL CONTRADICTS. Figures 11 and 12 share the caption pair 25/35 per cent and both axes print 'enthusiasim when churn rate=25%'; Figures 13 and 14 repeat the fault on benefit per month, so on this paper the second half of every comparison carries the first half's label [caption.verbatim].

The word 'enthusiasim' is misspelled on both p14 axis titles and the x title of Figure 20 prints 'Tme/month' with the letter missing; the record keeps the printed spelling in the note and does not repair it [caption.verbatim].

Four captions are typed from the crops because the p14 and p15 pairs weld two labels onto one printed line and drop the percentages to a second line, so the layer reports 'Figure 11: Working efficiency when churn rate isFigure 12: Working efficiency when churn rate is' as one string and neither label can be quoted whole [caption.verbatim].

Figures 17 and 18 are captioned '... of two recruitment' - the captions stop mid-phrase and never reach the word 'methods' that the rest of the series prints, so the truncation is recorded rather than completed [caption.verbatim].

Side-by-side panels are drawn on different windows in every pair: Figures 9/10 on 0.70-0.86 against 0.65-0.80, Figures 13/14 on 165-195 against 145-185, and Figures 7/8 near 160-200 against spikes to 300 - so no pair can be compared by shape, and only Figures 11/12 share a window [geometry.shared_axes].

Keys are placed four ways in one paper: under the tree (Figure 1), inside the plot (Figure 3 and both benefit scatters), outside the frame on the right (Figures 15 and 21) and under the plot at bottom right (Figures 16, 17 and 18), so a reader cannot rely on one position [geometry.legend].

Table 1 is the paper's only grid: three full-width rules at 471.5, 490.6 and 550.5 pt across 454.8 pt, no vertical, five columns and four numeric ones right-aligned to the cell edge rather than to the decimal point, so 0.929 and 0 line up by luck [table.decimal_aligned].

The section index is right on every figure row and wrong on the table row: Table 1 prints at 471.5-550.5 pt under '3.2 The analysis of multilayer network' at 209.9 pt while '4 Sensitivity Analysis' prints at 707.7 pt BELOW the grid, and both p20 figures are filed under '5 Conclusion' at 701.7 pt although they sit under '4.1' at 72.3 pt [place.section_path].

Citation is complete and flat: all twenty-one figures and the table are named in prose, eighteen of them exactly once on the page that prints them, Figure 2 twice on its own page, Figure 19 twice across p18 and p19, and Figure 16 alone is read a page after it prints [mention.count].

The pointers are written 'Figure.4' with a period and no space, while every caption prints 'Figure 4:' with a colon, so the paper uses two numbering systems that never touch; the body also names Figure 4 'employee churn algorithm' where the caption says 'dismission' [caption.numbering].

Text-layer losses to declare: every caption glyph run on pp6-20 reaches the layer with its spaces stripped ('Figure1: Staffdistributionstructureineachdivision'), and every vector axis title arrives reversed ('%52=etar' for 'rate=25%'), which is why all axis readings in this record came off the crops [caption.verbatim].
